pois.name: הגנים הבהאים
pois.description: גנים עם 19 טרסות של ערוגות פרחים גאומטריות, שמטפסות כל הדרך למקדש הבהאים עטוי הכיפה בהר הכרמל.
pois.intro: The Baháʼí Terraces, or the Hanging Gardens of Haifa, are garden terraces on Mount Carmel in Haifa, and one of the most popular tourist destinations in Israel. Completed in 2001, there are 19 terraces and more than 1,500 steps ascending the mountain.

pois.name: בית הצדק העולמי
pois.intro: The Universal House of Justice is the international governing body of the Baháʼí Faith. It was envisioned by Baháʼu'lláh, the founder of the Baháʼí Faith, as an institution that could legislate on issues not already addressed in the Baháʼí writings, providing flexibility for the Baháʼí Faith to adapt to changing conditions.

pois.name: כיפת הבאב
pois.intro: The Shrine of the Báb is a structure on the slopes of Mount Carmel in Haifa, Israel, where the remains of the Báb, founder of the Bábí Faith and forerunner of Baháʼu'lláh in the Baháʼí Faith, are buried; it is considered to be the second holiest place on Earth for Baháʼís, after the Shrine of Baháʼu'lláh in Acre.

pois.name: מוזיאון טיקוטין לאמנות יפנית
pois.intro: The Tikotin Museum of Japanese Art is a museum on the crest of Mount Carmel, in Haifa, Israel, dedicated to the preservation and exhibition of Japanese art. It is the only such museum in the Middle East.

pois.name: מוזיאון ההעפלה וחיל הים
pois.intro: The Clandestine Immigration and Naval Museum is a technical history museum located in Haifa, Israel. The museum covers the maritime history of Israel – from clandestine immigration during the British Mandate for Palestine through the history of the Israeli navy since its inception.

pois.name: מוזיאון חיפה לאמנות
pois.intro: The Haifa Museum of Art, established in 1951, is located in a historic building built in the 1930s in Wadi Nisnas, downtown Haifa. Ranking as Israel's third largest art museum, the museum focuses on Israeli and international contemporary art, and its collection includes 7,000 items, mostly of contemporary Israeli art.

pois.name: מוזיאון הרכבת
pois.intro: Israel Railway Museum is the national railway museum of Israel, located in Haifa. The railway museum is owned by Israel Railways and is located at the Haifa East Railway Station which nowadays no longer serves passengers.

pois.name: מדעטק - המוזיאון הלאומי למדע
pois.wikipedia: en:Israel National Museum of Science, Technology, and Space
pois.intro: The Israel National Museum of Science, Technology, and Space is a science and technology museum in the city of Haifa, Israel. The museum has approximately 400,000 visitors annually.

pois.name: מערת אליהו
pois.openingHours: summer Su-Th 08:00-18:00; winter Su-Th 08:00-17:00; Fr 08:00-13:00; PH off
pois.intro: Cave of Elijah is the name used for two grottoes on Mount Carmel, in Haifa, Israel, associated with Biblical prophet Elijah. According to tradition, Elijah is believed to have prayed at a grotto before challenging the priests of Baal on Mount Carmel, and to have hidden in either the same or in another nearby grotto from the wrath of Jezebel.

pois.name: תל אבו הואם
pois.description: תל אבו הַוַּאם ("הואם" הוא כינוי למין ציפור) הוא תל עתיק בדרום מפרץ חיפה.
pois.intro: Tell Abu Hawam is the site of a small city established in the Late Bronze Age in the area of modern-day Haifa, Israel. It was known to the Crusaders as Latin: Cayphas Vetusta and Latin: Vetus Cayphas.

pois.name: פארק שקמונה
pois.intro: Tell es-Samak or Tel Shikmona, meaning 'mound of the fish', is an ancient Phoenician tell situated near the sea coast in the modern city of Haifa, Israel, just south of the Israeli National Institute of Oceanography. It has been called a "forgotten Phoenician site".

pois.name: חי-בר כרמל
pois.intro: Carmel Hai-Bar Nature Reserve is a 1,500-acre breeding and acclimation center administered by the Israel Nature Reserves and National Parks Authority, situated in the Carmel mountains in northwestern Israel, within the larger Mount Carmel National Park. The Carmel Hai-Bar is the Mediterranean climate counterpart of the Yotvata Hai-Bar Nature Reserve which operates in the desert.

pois.name: המוזיאון הימי
pois.intro: The National Maritime Museum is a maritime and archaeological museum in Haifa, Israel. The museum was founded in 1953, based on the private collection of its founder and first director, Aryeh Ben-Eli.

pois.name: אח"י דקר
pois.intro: INS Dakar was a diesel–electric submarine in the Israeli Navy. The vessel, a modified World War II British T-class submarine, had previously been HMS Totem of the Royal Navy.

pois.name: מגדלור סטלה מאריס
pois.intro: Stella Maris Light, Mount Carmel Light, Har Carmel Light or Haifa Light, is a lighthouse in Haifa, Israel. It is located on the seaward face of Mount Carmel, near Stella Maris Monastery, inside an Israeli Navy base.

pois.name: מוזיאון מאנה-כץ
pois.intro: Музей Ма́не Каца — художественно-биографический музей, открытый в 1977 году в Хайфе, экспозиция которого посвящена произведениям художника Ма́не Ле́йзеровича Каца. Музей расположен на улице Ефе-Ноф в здании, из окон которого открывается красивый вид на город и на Хайфский залив.

pois.name: مشارق الأذكار
pois.nameEnglish: Centre for the Study of the Texts

pois.name: חיים ארלוזורוב
pois.intro: USCGC Unalga was a Miami-class cutter that served in the United States Revenue Cutter Service and later the U.S. Coast Guard and U.S. Navy. The early part of her career was spent patrolling the Pacific coast of the United States and the Bering Sea.

pois.name: Falafel HaZkenim
pois.intro: Falafel HaZkenim or Falafel Najala is an Israeli restaurant and falafel stand, located in Wadi Nisnas, Haifa. Since foundation, guests are greeted with a free falafel ball dipped in tahini.

pois.name: סינמול
pois.intro: Lev HaMifratz Mall, officially branded Cinemall, is a shopping mall located in Haifa, Israel.

pois.name: גן פסלי אורסולה מלבין
pois.intro: Хайфский сад скульптур — сад скульптур, расположенный в в Хайфе, в районе Адара, на проспекте Сионизма, неподалёку от Бахайского храма.

pois.name: גן בנימין
pois.description: הגן הציבורי הראשון בישראל, הוקם ב-1923. ב-1925, לרגל ביקור הברון בנימין רוטשילד בחיפה, נקרא הגן על שמו.

pois.name: גן מניה שוחט
pois.description: הגן הוקם ע"י הטמפלרים שבנו את כרמלהיים. במלחמת העולם הראשונה חסמו חיילים גרמנים את החיילים העותומנים שניסו לכרות את העצים. במקור נקרא הגן ע"ש אוגוסטה ויקטוריה-אשת הקייזר הגרמני ווילהם השני שביקר בחיפה בשנת 1898
